source_based_algorithm_constraints: Keep original single reference bus as angle/voltage reference. A temporary inner-PF real-power residual may occur but cannot survive final acceptance as an unlimited Clay source.
Separate original frozen PG, policy scheduled PG, and solved PG. Existing inner-input profile-preservation gate is insufficient to validate allocation against the original frozen profiles.
For each outer iterate rebuild the compact case after PG changes so source fingerprints and the gen view match. The passive interior stays zero-injection and voltage lifting remains exact.

Native eligibility cannot be inferred from GEN_STATUS alone: status represents admitted hourly capability, not observed commitment. Positive baseline PG and conventional fossil prime-mover screening are explicit proxies, not observed AGC membership.

External equivalents are regional signed injection resources, not native thermal machines. Their current Pmin=Pmax are artificial net-boundary-derived pins; use separately declared finite historical capability boxes if policy reformulates generation for losses.
HQ can have negative scheduledPG; do not apply a positive-P native-unit screen to it. Meter/load semantics must decide its loss responsibility because the HQ equivalent sits atNYbus48.

Actual regional NY-boundary targets must be measured at a declared terminal convention and audited individually. Adding regional internal loss to PG alone does not prove the boundary targets if inter-region exchanges can change.

Do not add modeled NY transmission losses a second time if source reported load already includes them; await the independent load/meter-semantics contract before choosing served-PD versus reported-load handling.

Keep six explicit DC P schedules and their existing loss contracts fixed; preserve converter VG/Qpolicy unless separately declared. Hold native power boxes and physical topology to the agreed parameter revision.

Use explicit fixed participation weights and a bounded allocation with saturation. If a regional budget cannot be accommodated, fail with capacity deficit; do not silently use the reference, relax bounds or move another region.
Treat outer allocations as fixed-point/constraint satisfaction, not OPF or an internal-interface fit. All P32 internal observations remain post-hoc evaluation only.
Recompute or audit external MVA/Q-circle capability consistently when externalPG changes. Keep real-power policy qualification separate from voltage,Q,thermal/security qualifications.
outer_iteration_review_points: Trace proposed regional budgets, allocated deltaPG, saturated rows, totalcapacity, stepnorm and observed boundary/reference residuals each iteration.
If undamped updates do not reduce residuals or innerNR fails, use documented bounded line-search/damping and reject the failed trial; retain the last valid iterate only as intermediate evidence.
Require both regional boundary/demand-contract residuals and original-reference residual below fixed tolerances; maximum iterations must return failure without promoting the final iterate.

Do not change fixed-point equations or loosen a tolerance after seeing internal NYISO errors. A successful native solve must be checked against a fresh detailed-network solve with identical scheduledPG/load/controls.
